entities.summary: Karolina Mykolayivna Protsenko, known since July 2025 as Karolina Rose, is a Ukrainian-born violinist, pianist, guitarist and singer performing contemporary pop music in the United States. She is an internet celebrity, and recorded street performance of music, primarily at Third Street Promenade in Santa Monica, California.
